finding.summary: Results are now stored in a dict keyed by file_path (graph.py ReviewState.results), and render() reads state["results"][f] per entry of state["files"]. A diff can legitimately contain two chunks with the same file_path (e.g. a file touched twice, or a rename whose target equals another chunk's path — chunker does not dedupe chunks). The old code reviewed each chunk independently and appended both results; the new code reviews the same chunk twice (next(c for c in ctx.diff.chunks if c.file_path == path) always picks the first match), the second result silently overwrites the first, and the report under-reports issues/summaries for one chunk.
finding.fix: Key results by chunk index (or a unique chunk id) instead of file_path, or dedupe/merge chunks by file_path in build_chunks so paths are unique before building initial_state.
